item.title: New Zealand’s ruling coalition falls just short of majority, needs centrist party’s support to govern
item.description: Official results on Friday showed Prime Minister Christopher Luxon fell just short of a parliamentary majority in this month's election.

item.title: Britain warns young male visitors of drink-spiking risk in Tokyo
item.description: The British Embassy in Tokyo is pushing the awareness campaign as data shows spiking cases have increased by more than half over the past seven years.

item.title: Dolls depicting 2026 newsmakers showcased in Tokyo
item.description: Figure skaters, a Nobel Prize winning scientist and a baseball giant are all part of the collection.

item.title: Faster inflation in Tokyo supports case for BOJ rate hike in December
item.description: The consumer price index excluding fresh food rose 2.9% in November from a year earlier in the capital, the highest level since July 2025, data shows.

item.title: Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind
item.description: The ousted prime minister's December homecoming plan deepens Dhaka-Delhi tensions and risks fresh unrest.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
